TEXT FIXTURE FOR tools/check-evidence.mjs --selftest

This file is test data, not a source document. It exists so the evidence checker's self-test does not
depend on data/sources/, which holds archived pages from the previous project and is not committed.

It is read the same way a real archive file is: as text with markup stripped and whitespace normalised.
The checker must still reject a number that is not here, and must still reject a real sentence that does
not carry the number it is attached to.

EXCERPT A: "provisional measures may be imposed not later than seven months from the date of initiation"

EXCERPT B: "the definitive duty applicable to the product concerned is set at 17.4 per cent"

The two sentences above are the only substantive lines. Everything else in this file is description, so a
passing check cannot be an accident of a stray match elsewhere in the text.

[END OF FIXTURE]
